children.name: How do I raise a claim?

textOverrides.Title Text: How do I raise a claim?
textOverrides.Body Text: Choose the insured policy, tell us what happened, and upload the requested documents.

children.name: Where can I download my policy documents?

textOverrides.Title Text: Where can I download my policy documents?
textOverrides.Body Text: Open a policy card and select View details. Your policy documents are available under Documents.

children.name: Can I change my cover during renewal?

textOverrides.Title Text: Can I change my cover during renewal?
textOverrides.Body Text: Yes. You can update your cover, add-ons, and personal details before completing renewal.
